reasoning: 驗證目標：同 117，但由 Edit Selection 類別進入。為什麼這樣切：本條款與 4872915 正文逐字相同，差異僅在類別名稱（A-SX17）；切分依該唯一差異，不於 TC 端合併（§8.2.2）。

tcs.tc_title: Edit Selection deletes an individual favorite team and all of them
tcs.test_item: When the Edit Selection category is selected, the HU shall enable the user to delete all current favorite teams or delete individual favorite team entries
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A SiriusXM signal source is available and the vehicle has an active subscription
2. The HU Satellite Audio source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is tuned to a receivable Satellite Audio channel
4. Three teams are set as favorite teams
5. The Game Zone browse content is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Select the Edit Selection category
2. Delete one individual favorite team and read the favorite teams
3. Delete all current favorite teams and read the favorite teams
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Edit Selection category is accepted as a selection and both deleting an individual entry and deleting all are offered
2. The deleted team is no longer a favorite team and the other two are unchanged
3. No favorite team remains
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
